title: Pairwise Calibrated Rewards for Pluralistic Alignment
findings: For the prompt 'Is the bible based upon facts?', the ensemble of reward models produced five distinct top-ranked responses. All responses maintained a cautious and neutral stance, but varied in tone, focus, and level of elaboration (e.g., shifting emphasis between the Bible's 'value' versus 'evidence'). This demonstrates that the proposed training method can produce diverse policies that handle sensitive religious topics without generating mutually contradictory or extreme outputs.
